lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 여기 처음 왔는데 제 자리가 어디예요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. It's my first time here. Where is my seat?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. yeogi cheoeum wanneunde je jariga eodiyeyo?
lines.learner: 안녕하세요. 표를 보여 주세요. 자리를 찾아 드릴게요.
lines.en: Hello. Please show me your ticket. I'll find your seat.
lines.roman: annyeonghaseyo. pyoreul boyeo juseyo. jarireul chaja deurilgeyo.

lines.learner: B구역은 무대 앞 중간에 있어요. 안쪽으로 가세요.
lines.en: Section B is in the middle, in front of the stage. Go inside.
lines.roman: bi-guyeogeun mudae ap junggane isseoyo. anjjogeuro gaseyo.

lines.beaver_en: In front of the stage? Which direction is the stage?
lines.en: The stage is over there. Go straight ahead.

lines.beaver_en: There are a lot of people. How do I get there?
lines.en: It's fine. Follow the yellow line on the floor.

lines.learner: 네, 가까이 있어요. 동쪽 출구 옆에 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, it's nearby. It's next to the east exit.
lines.roman: ne, gakkai isseoyo. dongjjok chulgu yeope isseoyo.

lines.learner: 출구는 동쪽과 서쪽에 있어요. 뒤쪽에도 있어요.
lines.en: The exits are on the east and west. There's one at the back too.
lines.roman: chulguneun dongjjokgwa seojjoge isseoyo. dwijjogedo isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 행사 끝나고 바깥에서 밥 먹고 싶어요.
lines.beaver_en: After the event, I want to eat outside.
lines.beaver_roman: haengsa kkeunnago bakkateseo bap meokgo sipeoyo.
lines.learner: 정문 앞 거리에 식당이 많아요. 주변에 카페도 있어요.
lines.en: There are many restaurants on the street in front of the main gate. There are cafes around too.
lines.roman: jeongmun ap georie sikdangi manayo. jubyeone kapedo isseoyo.

lines.learner: 아니요, 걸어서 오 분이에요. 아주 가까워요.
lines.en: No, it's five minutes on foot. It's very close.
lines.roman: aniyo, georeoseo o bunieyo. aju gakkawoyo.

lines.beaver: 이 고장에서 인기 있는 음식이 뭐예요?
lines.beaver_en: What food is popular in this area?
lines.beaver_roman: i gojangeseo ingi inneun eumsigi mwoyeyo?
lines.learner: 이 고장은 국수가 최고예요. 면이 아주 부드러워요.
lines.en: Noodles are the best here. The noodles are very soft.
lines.roman: i gojangeun guksuga choegoyeyo. myeoni aju budeureowoyo.

lines.beaver: 고마워요. 그럼 제 자리에 가 볼게요.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you. I'll go to my seat then.
lines.beaver_roman: gomawoyo. geureom je jarie ga bolgeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 즐겁게 보세요! 안내 센터는 정문 옆이에요.
lines.en: Okay, enjoy the show! The info center is next to the main gate.
lines.roman: ne, jeulgeopge boseyo! annae senteoneun jeongmun yeopieyo.
